highlights: The plain Wingman entry opens exactly the apps ticked Open when Wingman starts, whether or not Wingman is already running, and nothing when none is ticked; an app that is already open is brought forward, never opened twice.
An app's own launcher opens only that app, and a second click while Wingman is opening an app doesn't open it twice.
Unreadable settings never turn on Open when Wingman starts, and Wingman never writes over a settings file it can't read.
Wingman keeps a small local event log to help trace launch problems.
